title: Templar
summary: Templar is a red-and-gold armored Gaia-Titan. His face masked behind an armored helmet like the Caliban Titans, he is a fierce swordsman in battle. A mane of long, green hair flows down to his knees. His Amulet is in the possession of Lucas Casterwill.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Templar was invoked by Lucas to help defend the [[Fortress of Iron Will]] against the [[Blood Spiral]] army led by [[Kiel]]. He defeated a great number of [[Harlekin]]s and was seen tackling a [[Marauder]] when [[Nimue Casterwill|Nimue]] sacrificed herself. {{Source|The Spiral War}}

Templar later fought alongside [[Lunar]] and [[Solar]] against [[the Betrayer]]. They aimed a great deal of attacks on him but were defeated in a great energy storm caused by the Betrayer. {{source|Dante's Return}}

sections.wikitext:
As an extremely powerful swords master, this Titan is not one to be trifled with. He can also shoot energy from his blade. His body is protected by a strong defense of white energy and his right hand holds a magical sword made from bright light.
